name: fld_card_image_sq_finite_field
statement: (K : Type) [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] (h : ringChar K ≠ 2) : (Finset.univ.image (fun x : K => x ^ 2)).card = (Fintype.card K + 1) / 2
closed: ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] (h : ringChar K ≠ 2), (Finset.univ.image (fun x : K => x ^ 2)).card = (Fintype.card K + 1) / 2
informal: A finite field of odd characteristic with q elements has exactly (q+1)/2 squares. Generalizes Mathlib2.alg_card_range_sq_zmod_prime from ZMod p to all finite fields — squaring is 2-to-1 on nonzero elements (x^2 = y^2 iff x = ±y, and x ≠ -x as char ≠ 2), plus 0; q is odd.
type: ∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Fintype K] [inst_2 : DecidableEq K], ringChar K ≠ 2 → (Finset.image (fun x => x ^ 2) Finset.univ).card = (Fintype.card K + 1) / 2
